props.description: The trail from the root to the current page, drawn above the title; left out or empty, there is no trail.
props.name: breadcrumbs

props.description: The state of the page's record, drawn beside the title, usually a `StatusBadge`.
props.name: status

props.description: The page's actions in priority order: the first is primary, three at most show and the rest go in an ActionMenu.
props.name: actions

props.description: The accessible name of the ActionMenu button the overflowing actions go in. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: moreActionsLabel

props.description: What the region is about, in a few words. Required: it is the heading a screen reader jumps to.
props.name: title

props.description: One muted line under the title, for example what the section holds.
props.name: description

props.description: The title's place in the document outline, 1 to 6.
props.name: headingLevel

props.description: The spoken name of the region, for example "Main navigation"; required when the page holds two of its kind.
props.name: label

props.description: A node at the logical start of the bar, before its main content.
props.name: startContent

props.description: A node at the logical end of the bar, after its main content.
props.name: endContent

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
